nom: Avene Eau Thermale Avène – Sérum Concentré Nettoyant AntiImperfections – Minimise l’apparence des imperfections et non comédogène – Résultats longue durée – Pompe airless, 38

avis.texte: Es la segunda vez que lo compro es muy bueno me lo recetaron para mis marcas del acné pero si es muy fuerte pero efectivo

At age 46 I still break out, but after being super oily all my life... I now am also dealing with dry patches and my skin has become more reactive. Very frustrating. I like that I can use this on my areas where I breakout and get moisture while also helping treat and diminish my breakouts. It has never made my skin dry! Definitely worth a try. Also love the Avene "Thermal Spring Water" spray! It is super moisturizing but also super light, lile spraying water! I spray it on clean hands and pat ovwr my face, you can also just apray it on your face. I use that spray and then apply my moisturizer twice a day, LOVE both!!

avis.titre: Such a great product for minimizing comodomes
avis.texte: I love this product. I suffer with comodomes and I do find this product helps to minimize the quantity of breakouts I have. It is a staple in my routine!

avis.titre: In love with this product before finding it on Amazon
avis.texte: I already knew the benefits this product provides to my skin; i just couldn't find it anymore on any local store so i started looking for it on Amazon. That's how much i like it! Blemishes pretty much disappear overnight, as long as i use it on them on the first appearance, but still it works wonders with the "tougher-to-vanish" blemishes. In addition to oily and acne prone, my skin is also sensitive but somehow this product doesnt overdry or harms my skin like other products do that cause me redness and even new blemishes or take longer to make them go away. When i started using it, i realized i really found something amazing that really works for me; i dont know if either my country's humidity levels help with the non-drying or my own oily skin but the fact is this helps me and im willing to keep ordering it online for as long as i need to continue using it. PD. I've been using it with other Avene products for oily and acne prone skin, love them all! Cleasing gel, moisturizer and sun block lotion. After washing my face with the gel, i use a soft towel to dry it with soft quick touches until dry; then, i apply the blemish control serum on each blemish, wait until it dries and apply the sun block and then moisturizer with quick soft touches, all of this as directed by my dermatologist who introduced me to this brand.

avis.titre: Mi básico para mis granitos y espinillas
avis.texte: La primera vez que lo usé fue por una muestra y los usé en granos localizados. Funcionó y me animé por el producto. No me irrita, gradualmente seca las espinillas, sí huele de repente a alcohol pero desaparece a los pocos segundos. Cada día lo usé en unos enormes granos que me salieron y con los días se desinflamaron. Siento mi piel suave a pesar de ser tratamiento y uso como una gota por cada zona de la cara (frente y mejillas). Mi piel es mixta a grasa con tendencia a granitos y espinillas.
